meta.name: caveman
meta.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode that cuts output tokens while keeping technical accuracy. Levels: lite, full, ultra and the wenyan variants. Use for /caveman, "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "be brief" or "less tokens".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 AI 回复像电报一样精简,省时省钱。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果更想看要点、不想花时间读长回答。
copy.tagline_en: Make AI reply like a telegram: short, fast, cost-saving.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you prefer brief answers and want to skip verbose AI responses.

howto.what: 启用后，Claude 的回答会变短：删掉啰嗦话和客套，技术名词、代码、错误信息一字不改。这个风格持续整场对话，直到你说要停；遇到安全警告、不可逆操作等需要格外清楚的场合，会先恢复正常句子。
howto.when: 当用户说 “/caveman”、“caveman mode”、“talk like caveman” 等说法时触发该模式；直到用户说 “stop caveman” 或 “normal mode” 才结束。

say.text: 开启 caveman mode，回答：为什么 React 组件会重新渲染？
say.note: 此后所有回复都保持简短。

say.text: 用 /caveman full 解释数据库连接池。

howto.what_en: Once enabled, replies get terse. Filler and pleasantries dropped; code, terms, and errors stay exact. Style persists until stop; security warnings or irreversible actions get clear prose first.
howto.when_en: Triggered by '/caveman', 'caveman mode', 'talk like caveman', etc. Lasts until user says 'stop caveman' or 'normal mode'.

say_en.text: Enable caveman mode, then explain why React components re-render.
Use /caveman full to explain database connection pooling.
